lines.en: My horse walks the dirt road.
A bow hangs from the saddle.
I have come across the plains.

lines.zh: 这匹马是队里分给我的。
lines.en: This horse was issued to me.
Its gait is steady.
I watch both sides as I ride.
There are no villages in this stretch.
The wind presses the roadside grass down.
I draw the reins and slow.
There is smoke in the distance.
That is not cooking smoke.

lines.zh: 我把弓挪到顺手的位置。
lines.en: I shift the bow to where I can reach it.
The hooves sound muffled on the dirt road.
I wrap the reins around my hand.
There is a rise ahead.
The horse knows this road.
I sit on the horse and wait.
The horse grazes, head down.
I check the quiver.
About twenty left.
The shield hangs at my off hand.
The sun is a little to the west.
This would do for a camp.
But we still have road ahead.
The horse snorts.
I pat its neck.
I lay the bow across the saddle.
The horse paws beneath me.
This is a good horse.
The company has worse ones.
I rarely get out of the saddle.

lines.zh: 我把箭袋的带子紧了紧。
lines.en: I tighten the quiver strap.
You stand in the middle of the road.
My horse slowed.
Are you passing, or blocking?
Where are your hands?
I can see your hands.
Keep both hands empty.
That will save us both trouble.
You took your hat off.
That means friendship, I take it.
You wait at the roadside for me to pass.
Then go on ahead.
I rein the horse to a halt.
I duck low over the horse's neck.
A line of blood opens on my shoulder.
The horse shies.
I bring it back under control.
I let out a breath.
I duck low, shielding the horse.
I wipe the blood on the saddle blanket.
I check that the horse is unhurt.

lines.zh: 我抓紧缰绳，没有掉下去。
lines.en: I grip the reins and stay in the saddle.
I look at you and say nothing.
That is bread in your hand.
My horse smelled it first.
Toss half of it over.
Keep the rest.
We do not take by force.
I take it and break it in half.
The other half to the horse.

lines.zh: 你们这些人总带着吃的。
lines.en: Your kind always carry food.
I have only dry rations.
Dry rations are not this.
I tuck the bread into the saddlebag.
You hand over the whole thing.
We will split it between the two of us.
The horse should get some too.
There is a little left on your hands.
Keep it for yourself.
Your shoulder brushed my horse.
It sidestepped once.
You startled it.
Step back a little.
The horse sidesteps once.
You pass beside us.
You walk close to the horse's legs.
It does not like that.
My horse veered left one step.
You passed on the right.
I serve in the company.
That waits until the fighting is done.
You are young; do not rush.
I do not stay long here.
The company does not allow it.
My road is still ahead.

lines.zh: 我连自己的营地都还没站稳。
lines.en: I have not even settled my own camp.
The horse needs looking after too.
I have no such plans in the company.
My life is all on the road.
There is a broken arrow on the ground.
I lean down and pick it up.
It can be trimmed into another.
I hang it from the saddle.
I will deal with it back at camp.
There is another, unbroken, on the ground.
I stow it in the quiver too.
The saddlebag still has room.
I weigh it in my hand.
It caught on my sleeve.
You have drawn your weapon.
I raise a hand on horseback.
Do not be in a rush.
I pull the reins left.
The horse turns broadside.
Now I have my angle.
I lift the bow from the saddle.
You still have time to put it down.
I must read the wind first.
The wind favors you.
I circle you from the saddle.
You turn on the spot.
The horse turns faster than you.
I open the distance a little.
A bow is awkward from the saddle.
So I make room first.
Your steps are slower than the horse.
I need not come too close.
On horseback, my arrow is already nocked.
I rein in the horse and hold.
I loose the string and the arrow.

lines.zh: 箭从你的护肩旁边过去。
lines.en: The arrow passes your shoulder guard.
I change position at once.
You charge and I pull back.
The horse carries me clear.
Then one more arrow after it.
The arrow lands in the dirt.
I draw another.
Your shoulder plate caught it.
I have noted that spot.
I come from the far end of the road.
Bow and quiver hang at the saddle.
This horse is not my own.
The company issued it.
I take up the reins.
Only one set of hoofprints is on the road.
They are from my coming.
I tug the horse's ear.
It raises its head.
I pull the horse up.

lines.zh: 火燎到马鬃，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches the mane; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 我从马上翻下来，摔在土里。
lines.en: I come off the horse into the dirt.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我抓着马鞍的带子。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I grip the saddle strap.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的马惊得跳起来。
lines.en: The blast startles my horse into a leap.
An arrow sticks in my leg armor.

lines.zh: 那法术让我手一松，弓掉了。
lines.en: That spell loosens my hand and the bow falls.

lines.zh: 口粮吃完了，马也慢下来。
lines.en: Rations are gone and the horse slows.
Lightning strikes and the horse rears.
There is nothing under the horse.
